checks.name: independent-clippy
checks.command: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features --locked --manifest-path truelearner/Cargo.toml -p truelearner-embodiment -p truelearner-workstation -- -D warnings

findings: The driver category has executable identity, serial composition, parallel composition, homogeneous banks, routing, and cause-preserving fan-out with ordinary Rust types.
Two independent change detectors preserve separate binocular values and histories; changing one eye produces one transition without changing the other eye's sample.
Five independent bounded axes move one selected finger and return only that finger's physical cause; invalid bank arity leaves every axis unchanged.
Independent held-out compositions with three sensor factors and seven actuator-feedback factors preserve local state, incidence, and origin.
Quantization followed by change detection and threshold factorization preserves ordinal crossings while marking only the final changed bin as a physical transition.

The workstation now reuses bounded magnitude, signed channels, quantization, and opposed effort while its checkpoint, replay, binocular rendering, semantic firewall, and visual-reach control remain unchanged.
residual_uncertainty: The library supplies composition mechanics, not a binocular-depth, independent-finger-control, reach, click, typing, or grasping capability claim.
The workstation currently reuses pure primitives only; migrating complete receptor banks, actuator axes, and morphology wiring requires a separate behavior-preserving plan.
Future sensors with asynchronous I/O or real device delay will need an explicit boundary adapter while preserving the same deterministic driver and physical-time laws.
